script_text: This week, Uranus, the Air element, shatters your 10th House, turning every career ambition into a mirage you cannot ignore. Monday brings Mercury squaring Mars in the 12th House, leaving you prone to mental exhaustion and restless. Tuesday, Saturn trines the Sun in the 10th House, grounding your ambitious projects with steady, consistent patience. Mid-week, Venus enters the 11th House and forms a trine with Mars, igniting your drive. Thursday, the Sun opposes Neptune in the 12th House, drenching your emotional life in a profound stillness. By the weekend, Jupiter enters the 1st House, restoring your self-confidence and personal power. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Monday is the worst day as Uranus squares the Sun in the 12th House. Dedicate one hour each morning to writing down your intentions, and the week's energy will align. Follow for daily updates.
